description: This file defines the RetryMiddlewareV2 class, which implements a middleware component for handling retries of failed AWS SDK requests. It supports 'standard' and 'adaptive' modes, manages retry policies, throttling detection, and delay strategies, and interfaces with quota management and rate limiting components.

classes.name: RetryMiddlewareV2
classes.description: Middleware class responsible for retrying failed AWS requests with support for standard and adaptive modes, including configuration, delay calculation, and error handling logic.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Static method that returns a middleware factory function wrapping a handler with RetryMiddlewareV2 instance.

methods.name: createDefaultDecider
methods.description: Creates a default decision function to determine if a request should be retried based on errors, quotas, and attempt count.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the RetryMiddlewareV2 instance with configuration, handler, and options.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Main middleware invocation method that manages retry attempts, delay strategies, and error handling for each request.

methods.name: exponentialDelayWithJitter
methods.description: Calculates exponential backoff delay with jitter based on attempt count.

methods.name: isRetryable
methods.description: Determines if a given result or error is eligible for a retry based on error type, code, or status.

methods.name: isThrottlingError
methods.description: Checks if a result indicates a throttling error.
